notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.5
notes.notes:
[p]Keep your eyes PEELED (that sounds painful) over the next couple of weeks for exciting news coming out of Grumpy Pizza HQ - a.k.a. my spare bedroom - regarding Go Kart Island... but in the mean time you'll have to settle for a new demo update.

Look at all this stuff. LOOK AT IT![b]

NEW FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Kart steering amounts are increased when driving at slow speeds[/p][/*][*][p]Start boost is applied by holding only acceleration, rather than both brake and acceleration[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for native Steam Deck resolution 1280x800, and also 1920x1200 'cause YOLO[/p][/*][*][p]Various SFX balances and updates[/p][/*][*][p]Race checkpoints (white and purple smoke columns) are no longer present[/p][/*][*][p]Various optimisations[/p][/*][*][p]UI and SFX changes to highlight when only one heart remains in Death Races[/p][/*][*][p]Shadows now appear directly underneath Squish-E-Boi obstacles[/p][/*][*][p]Info messages (that appear at the bottom of the screen) are displayed on screen for longer[/p][/*][*][p]Farm Race: Disabled the silver coin next to the starting grid until the 1st lap and added extra tyre walls[/p][/*][*][p]Improved directing the player in the tutorial mission[/p][/*][*][p]Added a message to direct player to find the paint shop after finding first collectable kart[/p][/*][*][p]Added a prompt after completing the demo to play Challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Improved "locked" and "trophy" icons[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the main menu getting into a state where no buttons could be selected with a controller[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the kart selection button from being pressed multiple times, which caused the selected Challenge to load multiple times[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed invincibility being stuck on permanently (for real this time, I think)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed AI racers not apply correct start boost values[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed new laps not triggering on the Farm Race[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the respawning positions on the "Chicken Run" collect event[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to outrun the Squish-E-Boi item without using a speed boost[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed slowdown penalty being applied when hit by a laser while the shield was active[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed oil and egg appearing to float slightly above ground[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the collision of donut obstacles so you can't pass under them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed yacht in Main Town not having any collision[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed benches props not resetting position[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed duplicated SFX playing on the character selection screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.3
notes.notes:
[p]Hello! 

I've been hard at work getting the full game ready for playtesting, and in the process there's been a load of changes that affect the demo, so I guess it's update time! 

Why not get this downloaded onto your computer box and give them a go? DO IT!
[b]

NEW FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Made some tweaks to the kart handling to make it feel less "floaty"[/p][/*][*][p]Added a controls screen that can be accessed from the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "hole" to the moving mayor board obstacle, so their location is always visible[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX when passing through race checkpoints[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX for the train[/p][/*][*][p]Balancing pass of various existing sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI tweaks and improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fuel pump props can be hit and explode [/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked shadow appearances on various surfaces[/p][/*][*][p]The chicken feeder prop is no longer static, will be moved by the player when hit[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the position of some collectable items[/p][/*][*][p]Sand slows down karts slightly more[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed the "Exit to Desktop" button to "Exit Game" when playing on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Added splash screen
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed instance where the driftsliding state would not stop when expected[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed behind camera being stuck "on" after being hit or after an event ended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various textures that were not displaying as intended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Lachlan minimap icon alignment[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed music being audible when the loading screen appeared, while music volume was set to 0[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed racers in the "Follow the Husband!" event stopping when the player kart was in front of them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a duplicated fence near the marina[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed NPCs that were misaligned with their karts [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Shelly not facing the player kart when being dropped off at home in the tutorial event[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.2
notes.notes:
[p]Hello!

A couple of updates have been pushed over the last week - mostly minor updates and balancing tweaks. Have a look here, I made a handy list. Don't say I don't treat you.

v0.2.2[/p][list][*][p]Improved kart landings after using a jump pad so speed is not reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced "Wedding Dash" and "Mrs Ham's Private Bus" time trials[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced "Chicken Run" collect event time limits[/p][/*][*][p]Pole added to laser obstacles[/p][/*][*][p]Changed default camera damping to lowest setting[/p][/*][*][p]Changed default SFX volume to 8[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented the item tutorial appearing on a new save game[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed kart momentum not stopping when respawning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the minimap not rotating 45 degrees using the perspective camera[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]v0.2.1[/p][list][*][p]New NPC characters: Giraffe, Zebra, Bat and Flamingo[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision on the donut obstacles[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collision on fences[/p][/*][*][p]Updated best time/score star icon in Challenges[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.notes:
[p]The second number went up this time instead of the third number so you know this is a BANGER update.[/p][p][b]
NEW FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added three different difficulties - Rookie (Easy), Pro (Normal) and Champion (Hard)[/p][/*][*][p]Added three save slots for Story Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added the paint shop, allowing you to change kart colour in Story Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of laps in the Town, Forest and Farm races from 3 to 5[/p][/*][*][p]Updated character models for Hank, Cali and Rich Penelope[/p][/*][*][p]New music added when exploring the game world in Story Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Various new UI visuals implemented[/p][/*][*][p]The intro tutorial event can now be skipped if it has been completed once[/p][/*][*][p]The game now pauses when the gamepad is disconnected[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to modify the amount of horizontal camera yaw/damping applied when turning[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
BUG FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed laser item slowing you down when you were invincible or big[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed laser slowdown not being applied after a boost ended[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "use item" tutorial message not being removed in some circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to go under speed boosters when in the squished state[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed barrier items not moving after being hit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed SFX balancing for "size increase" and "laser" items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collectables panel appearing on the pause menu during Challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Squish-E-Boi item appearing after a race concludes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various prop placement bugs [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.4
notes.notes: [p]Hello! I have fixed some issues and implemented a couple of features that were raised over the weekend. That's all. THANKS BYE.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a button to skip dialogue and start an event immediately[/p][/*][*][p]Moved colliders on jumping donut and mayor board obstacles so they aren't clipped as easily when underground[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs rotate to face Lachlan when talking[/p][/*][*][p]Allow players to close the "success" screen when the money count up animation is playing[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the UI used for the "distance bar" on the Pursuit event[/p][/*][*][p]Moved some trees in the forest area and added extra tyre barriers during the checkpoint race[/p][/*][*][p]Added the total amount of available collectables to the pause menu display[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed not being able to open the pause menu in some circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed skidding SFX not stopping when triggering a dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed green artefacts being visible on the minimap in lower resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the laser item hitting time checkpoints[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed item tutorial text not scaling correctly on lower resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shadows not appearing on some surfaces[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dialogue sometimes disappearing early when entering the town in the tutorial event[/p][/*][/list]
